newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU GDP growth slows in 1st quarter - Eurostat.
newsitem.headline: EU GDP growth slows in 1st quarter - Eurostat.

text.p: European Union (EU) gross domestic product grew 0.1 percent in the first quarter from the previous three months, lagging growth than in the United States and Japan, Eurostat said on Thursday.
The rise was mainly due to a small increase in private consumption, the EU's statistics office said in a statement.
Fourth-quarter 1996 growth was 0.3 percent, it said.

Among the EU member states included in Eurostat's figures, only Britain (one percent), Spain (0.9 percent) and France (0.3 percent) showed growth between the fourth quarter of last year and the first quarter of 1997.
Eurostat figures included nine of the EU's 15 member states.
In the United States, GDP rose 1.5 in the same period while Japan grew 1.6 percent.
